units.configurations.properties.value: numeric or null; unit required per property
units.feedback.control: 1 very little to 5 very much; null = not answered
units.feedback.difficulty: 1 very easy to 5 very difficult; null = not answered
units.feedback.enjoyment: 1 not at all to 5 very much; null = not answered
units.predictions.confidence: 0 to 1 model-reported score, NOT calibrated probability

tables.studies: id PK; protocolVersion and consentVersion identify information shown; publicRecruitment is always false.
tables.configurations: id PK; studyId FK studies.id; equipment is raw description; properties contain units, source and observation status.
tables.sessions: id PK; studyId FK; configurationId FK; participantId pseudonym; groupId episode/source grouping; consent is the recorded choice, not proof of institutional approval. mediaId is a local opaque reference, never video bytes.
tables.events: id PK; sessionId FK; label/outcome/note are original observations; components are researcher-supplied typed strings. Intervals must lie inside sessions. annotationVersion stays 1.
tables.feedback: id PK; sessionId FK; optional eventId FK within that session. Custom pilot questions, not a validated psychological scale. Raw text is never paraphrased.
tables.comparisons: id PK; sessionA/sessionB FK. Human observations do not establish identical states or causal effects. Controlled simulations require state/seed/controller references.
tables.reviews: id PK; eventId FK; append-only originalLabel/correctedLabel, decision, notes, timestamp and consecutive annotationVersion. Latest version is a reviewed label, not a replacement raw report.
tables.predictions: id PK; eventId FK; separate imported machine suggestion with model/version/prompt/interval/limitations. Always unreviewed; ML permission required.
tables.split_groups: Connected sessions sharing a participant, source group or comparison pair. Keep entire leakageGroup together. Partition is intentionally unassigned; this is not a validated train/test split.
tables.session_coverage: Derived whole-workspace view. Session duration and union of raw annotation intervals, including uncertain/excluded events; overlapping intervals count once within a session.
tables.event_review_status: Derived whole-workspace view. Raw label and latest appended human review label/status/version side by side; pending means no human review. Not a model accuracy measure.

limitations: No hidden engine telemetry is inferred.
Own-play and convenience samples do not represent a population.
Synthetic data are never empirical findings.
Exports contain free text and may contain private evidence references. Review them before sharing. No contact/account fields or video bytes are included.
